items.title: File Widerspruch against Pflegegrad decision
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: Sender is a Pflegekasse, a social-law body under SGB XI, so the delivery-fiction rules of § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X apply (same 3-/4-day rule family as other social insurers), and the delivery day does NOT shift for weekends/holidays (that shift only applies to tax offices under § 108 Abs. 3 AO). Letter dated Fri 28.03.2025, no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date given, so posting day = 28.03.2025. Posted after 1 Jan 2025 → 4-day rule: 28.03 + 4 calendar days = Tue 01.04.2025 (29=1, 30=2, 31=3, 01.04=4). This is not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so it stands as the deemed delivery date. One-month Widerspruch period per § 84 SGG: delivery day (01.04.2025) is not counted (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB); the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) → 01.05.2025. That day, 1 May, is 'Tag der Arbeit', a nationwide public holiday, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline moves to the next working day: Friday 02.05.2025.

items.title: Recurring monthly Pflegegeld payment
items.quote: Wir zahlen es jeweils zum Monatsende auf Ihr Konto.
items.computation: The letter grants Pflegegeld of 347,00 € per month starting February 2025, paid 'jeweils zum Monatsende' (each month-end) for as long as the person self-arranges care. This is a recurring, open-ended payment with no single fixed due date stated (no exact day-of-month given for 'Monatsende'), so no precise one-off deadline can be computed; it recurs every month indefinitely.

warnings: The Pflegegeld payment is recurring ('jeweils zum Monatsende') without an exact calendar day specified, so no single payment due date could be computed — check your bank statement for the actual monthly credit date.
